title: Compute equilibrium H2O and CO2 melt contents for rhyolitic melt at 850°C, 2000 bar, NNO+1
action: Obtain and run D-Compress (or implement its chemical model) for the C-O-H system with rhyolitic melt at 850°C, 2000 bar, and redox state NNO+1. Output the computed H2O and CO2 melt weight fractions (wt%).
description: Equilibrium weight fractions of H2O and CO2 dissolved in the rhyolitic melt (wt%) for the specified P–T–redox condition.
